description: Deterministic SQLite benchmark for the M2 text-to-SQL agent

cases.question: Show the names of customers from Chennai, ordered by customer ID
cases.reference_sql: SELECT name FROM customers WHERE city = 'Chennai' ORDER BY customer_id

cases.question: Show the customer IDs and names of customers whose city is unknown
cases.reference_sql: SELECT customer_id, name FROM customers WHERE city IS NULL

cases.question: Count customers for each name, including names that occur more than once, ordered alphabetically
cases.reference_sql: SELECT name, COUNT(*) as customer_count FROM customers GROUP BY name ORDER BY name

cases.question: Show each order ID, customer name, and amount, ordered by order ID
cases.reference_sql: SELECT o.order_id, c.name, o.amount FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_id

cases.question: Show order IDs for orders with an amount greater than 1000, ordered by order ID
cases.reference_sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE amount > 1000 ORDER BY order_id

cases.question: Show order IDs with an amount exactly equal to 100, ordered by order ID
cases.reference_sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE amount = 100 ORDER BY order_id

cases.question: Show order IDs with an amount greater than 100, ordered by order ID
cases.reference_sql: SELECT order_id FROM orders WHERE amount > 100 ORDER BY order_id

cases.question: Count customers whose city is NULL
cases.reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as unknown_city_count FROM customers WHERE city IS NULL
